title: Metrocentro relatives protest described by Havana Times
notes: The coordinator’s ordinary-HTTPS reading verifies an article published Dec. 13, 2019 describing the relatives’ Metrocentro action on Dec. 12, 2019. This is outside January 2021 and is not evidence for the separate undated Divergentes family-protest account.

title: Opposition protest dispersed in Managua, May 2021
notes: The opened IACHR annual-report bibliography dates the Yahoo Noticias protest report to May 28, 2021. A search-only Diario Libre/EFE result describes about ten UNAB participants split into two groups; the original cited story remains unread, and the qualitative estimate is retained with its source limitation. The event is outside January 2021.

title: Opponents reportedly detained after protest, article dated April 22, 2021
notes: The opened IACHR bibliography identifies a Despacho 505 article dated Apr. 22, 2021 titled “At least 12 opponents detained for protesting against Ortega in the last week.” The event date and crowd size are not established; the number of detainees is not turnout. The report concerns the April boundary, not January. The original article remains unread.
